gen-gf-warnes-bitter: Wide, stretched, ink-tapered letters with no thick or thin. Bitter follows in a slab-serif with a very large lowercase, so a long page feels grounded and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-grandstander-mulish: Mulish has a large x-height, short ascenders and apertures like a horseshoe magnet, so its plain sans lines read without strain. Grandstander adds the bold, expressive punch.
gen-gf-tektur-rubik: Rubik's big lowercase and open rounds read clearly, even small. Tektur gives pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase for attention, while Rubik quietly carries the actual reading.
gen-gf-gugi-mulish: Gugi stands tall, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Mulish, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, brings an approachable softness, and that gentle opposition is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-paprika-inter: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals and hollow-reed counters. Inter, in a smooth tube-like stroke of constant weight, sits underneath and gives that boldness a steadier footing.
gen-gf-warnes-roboto-slab: Warnes stretches out with tapered ink strokes and no difference between thick and thin. Roboto Slab then packs a dense middle zone and open throats, giving that spacious heading a structured slab-serif partner.
gen-irish-grover-bitter: Tall, sturdy lowercase makes every Irish Grover word look large and friendly. Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, backs it up so the thick heading strokes lead without overpowering.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-rubik: Tilt Neon draws a marker-like constant line with a splayed c terminal and a large x-height. Rubik's big lowercase and open rounds in a soft sans take over for the reading underneath.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-mulish: Mulish comes with a large x-height, short ascenders and open, horseshoe-shaped apertures, all drawn without any thick-and-thin modulation. Paragraphs of it should flow smoothly beneath Love Ya Like A Sister.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-instrument-sans: Boldness drives Snowburst One, a stencil with wide bridges between its tall lowercase letters. And Instrument Sans, a plain sans with a stroke weight that never varies, keeps long paragraphs smooth and quiet.
